## What this is

**eShop is a .NET Aspire–orchestrated microservices reference application** — an e-commerce store (catalog, basket, ordering, payments, webhooks, identity) built with minimal APIs, gRPC, EF Core/PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, MediatR/CQRS with DDD aggregates, and Blazor + .NET MAUI front ends. The solution `eShop.slnx` contains 19 projects plus 5 test projects (`eShop.slnx:1`).

## The composition root

`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs` is the single runnable entry point that starts everything: `DistributedApplication.CreateBuilder(args)` … `builder.Build().Run()` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:3`, `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:103`). It declares three container resources — Redis `redis`, RabbitMQ `eventbus`, and Postgres `postgres` on the `ankane/pgvector` image (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:7-13`) — plus four databases: `catalogdb`, `identitydb`, `orderingdb`, `webhooksdb` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:15-18`).

## Processes started when the solution runs

Eight `AddProject` services, one YARP proxy resource, and three containers:

| Aspire name | Project | Kind | Composed of |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity-api` | Identity.API | Duende IdentityServer + ASP.NET Identity MVC | `identitydb`; external HTTP endpoints; `/health` check (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:23-26`, host at `src/Identity.API/Program.cs:1-38`) |
| `basket-api` | Basket.API | **gRPC only** — `app.MapGrpcService<BasketService>()` | `redis` + `eventbus`, `Identity__Url` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:30-33`, `src/Basket.API/Program.cs:12`) |
| `catalog-api` | Catalog.API | Minimal-API Web API, versioned + OpenAPI | `eventbus` + `catalogdb`; `app.MapCatalogApi()` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:36-38`, `src/Catalog.API/Program.cs:20`) |
| `ordering-api` | Ordering.API | Versioned minimal API, authorized | `eventbus` + `orderingdb`, `/health`, `Identity__Url`; `orders.MapOrdersApiV1().RequireAuthorization()` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:40-44`, `src/Ordering.API/Program.cs:20-22`) |
| `order-processor` | OrderProcessor | Worker (hosted service) | `eventbus` + `orderingdb`, `WaitFor(orderingApi)` for EF migrations; runs `GracePeriodManagerService` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:46-49`, `src/OrderProcessor/Extensions/Extensions.cs:18`) |
| `payment-processor` | PaymentProcessor | Worker / bus subscriber | `eventbus` only; subscribes `OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEvent` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:51-52`, `src/PaymentProcessor/Program.cs:5-6`) |
| `webhooks-api` | Webhooks.API | Web API | `eventbus` + `webhooksdb`, `Identity__Url` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:54-57`) |
| `webhooksclient` | WebhookClient | Blazor Server | reference to `webhooks-api`, `IdentityUrl` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:65-67`, `src/WebhookClient/Program.cs:25-29`) |
| `webapp` | WebApp | Blazor Server storefront (main UI) | references `basket-api` (gRPC), `catalog-api`, `ordering-api`, `eventbus`; waits for identity; forwards `/product-images/{id}` to catalog (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:69-77`, `src/WebApp/Program.cs:29-33`) |
| `mobile-bff` | YARP resource (not a project) | Reverse proxy for the mobile client | routes `/catalog-api/*`, ordering and identity clusters (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:60-62`, `src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:185-215`) |

Identity is wired back to all apps for OIDC callback URLs — a deliberate cyclic reference (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:97-101`). HTTP vs HTTPS launch profile is chosen by the `ESHOP_USE_HTTP_ENDPOINTS` env var (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:20`, `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:108-115`). Two optional AI integrations (OpenAI, Ollama) are compiled in but disabled by hardcoded `false` flags (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:80-90`).

## What does *not* start with the solution

`ClientApp` (.NET MAUI) and `HybridApp` (MAUI Blazor Hybrid) are in the solution but are **not** launched by the AppHost — there is no `AddProject` for either in `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs`; they are run separately and reach the backend through `mobile-bff`. The shared libraries `EventBus`, `EventBusRabbitMQ`, `IntegrationEventLogEF`, `Ordering.Domain`, `Ordering.Infrastructure`, `WebAppComponents`, and `eShop.ServiceDefaults` have no entry point of their own.

## Message flow between the processes

The services are joined by 13 RabbitMQ integration events, e.g. Ordering→Basket (`OrderStartedIntegrationEvent`, `src/Ordering.API/Application/Commands/CreateOrderCommandHandler.cs:32`), Ordering→PaymentProcessor (`OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEvent`, `src/Ordering.API/Application/DomainEventHandlers/OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedDomainEventHandler.cs:30`), PaymentProcessor→Ordering (`src/PaymentProcessor/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:27`), OrderProcessor→Ordering (`src/OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs:55`), and Catalog→Webhooks (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:350`).

One caveat: I did not run the app, so the "starts when the solution runs" list is derived from the AppHost declarations rather than observed runtime behaviour; a resource could still fail its `WaitFor` dependency at startup.
